subject: prd/maintenance-sweep
statement: When invoked, the sweep shall evaluate exactly its closed detector set over the evaluated state (§4.1) and emit one typed finding per detected condition, each carrying detector, subject, evidence, and a named remedy.
rationale: the findings contract is the product (brainstorm:maintenance-sweep#D-3)
fit_criterion: on the fixture corpus, every emitted finding carries all four fields and cites a real condition; no detector outside the closed set runs
